items.title: Disney earnings show consumers will still pay up for experiences
items.summary:
Siebert Financial chief investment officer Mark Malek and his panel of experts weigh in on how resilient the US consumer looks heading into the holidays, with Disney (DIS) reporting a strong fourth quarter and premium experiential spending, like Viking Cruises (VIK), holding up.

Today's panel includes Yahoo Finance's Julie Hyman, Solidarity Wealth CEO Jeff McClean, Roundhill Investments ETF strategist Thomas DiFazio, and Alumni Ventures managing partner Laura Rippy.

items.title: Disney streaming, Marvel films are secret superpowers in Q4 profit beat
items.summary:
While Disney (DIS) topped fiscal fourth quarter profit estimates — powered by its Marvel film releases and its streaming operations — the stock is still taking a dip in Tuesday's pre-market trading.

The 8:30 Hosts Jake Conley, Julie Hyman, and Pras Subramanian take a closer look at Disney's streaming and parks divisions.

items.title: Earnings Beat Might Change The Bull Case For Disney Stock (DIS)
items.summary: Walt Disney reported past fiscal Q4 and full year 2026 results with US$25.95b in quarterly sales, US$2.61b in quarterly net income, full year revenue of US$102.34b and full year net income of US$9.90b. items.title: Disney earnings analysis: questions answered and next catalysts
items.summary: Investing.com -- Walt Disney Company (DIS) reported FY2026 Q4 today, Nov 17, 2026. It beat on both lines: EPS of $1.77 vs $1.68 expected (+5.36%) and revenue of $25.95B vs $25.21B. The stock was still at $116.82 (-1.58%) as of Nov 17, 3:19 PM EST. That is about 5% below the $122.72 52-week high set today, and the intraday range suggests early buying was sold into.
